description: This file defines the 'Returns' model class for the admin sale module in an OpenCart project. It provides methods for managing return records, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving return data and associated histories from the database.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Model class for handling return records in the sale module, including operations for CRUD, status updates, and histories.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Creates a new return record in the database with provided data and returns the new return ID.

methods.name: editReturn
methods.description: Updates an existing return record identified by return ID with new data.

methods.name: editReturnStatusId
methods.description: Updates the return status ID of an existing return record.

methods.name: deleteReturn
methods.description: Deletes a return record and its associated histories from the database.

methods.name: getReturn
methods.description: Retrieves a return record by return ID, including customer and status information.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Fetches a list of return records based on filter criteria, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Returns the total number of return records matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnStatusId
methods.description: Returns the total count of returns with a specific status ID.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnReasonId
methods.description: Returns the total count of returns with a specific reason ID.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnActionId
methods.description: Returns the total count of returns with a specific action ID.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new history entry for a return, optionally notifying relevant parties.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history records associated with a specific return.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves history records for a return, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns total history records for a specific return.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesByReturnStatusId
methods.description: Returns total history records with a specific return status ID.
